bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (audio client re-export), springboard/src/svc.rs (audio module), springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (player capsule), springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs, springboard/src/shell/music/system.rs, springboard/src/media/queue.rs
summary: Apps can play a queue, transport, shuffle, repeat and volume through the audio service client, and the shell shows Now Playing on the lock screen and in Control Center. Apps have no library query API, no media picker, no app-facing remote command handlers and no playlist or rating API; the media library lives inside the Music app.

features.note: app-facing playback over the audio service; no controller object with playback state notifications for media items, and no system music app handoff
one queue per speaker (last PlayQueue wins), play next and play last exist in the queue module; no immutable queue or descriptor types exposed to the SDK

gaps: No app-facing media library: no query, filter, collection or library change API (MPMediaQuery, MPMediaLibrary); the scan lives in springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs.

No remote command handlers for apps (MPRemoteCommandCenter); Control Center transport and hardware media keys are not exposed to apps (springboard/src/bare/input.rs:826 notes the media-key remote but does not map it).
No playlist, rating or feedback model in the SDK (MPMediaPlaylist, MPRatingCommand); favourites and playlists are private to the Music app.
No volume slider or output route picker widget for apps (MPVolumeView).
Now Playing fields cannot be set by apps beyond the audio service track; no animated artwork and no language options (MPNowPlayingInfoLanguageOption).
